what: Fail-closed guard colocated with module-level skipif
scenario_or_breakage: A sentinel test in the same module inherits pytestmark; any broadened skipif (e.g. re-adding script-exists) skips the guard too, so make py-test stays green while parity never runs under bash
suggested_fix: Place the guard in a separate always-collected module (e.g. test_finalize_bash_parity_gate.py) that asserts skipif is bash-absence-only and that parity tests are collected when shutil.which("bash") is set
